newsitem.title: UK: UK physical grain little changed and quiet.
newsitem.headline: UK physical grain little changed and quiet.

text.p: UK physical grain prices were little changed on Tuesday on a quiet market.
Traders said buyers were starting to show an interest again, but business was slow to start.
"We've had a gentle touch on the accelerator, but no doubt it will be followed by a damn great foot on the brake," said a trader.
On the fob market feed wheat traded at 97.50 stg for January and 98.50 stg for February ex-east coast ports.
Delivered market traders said the market was "difficult".
"It's not been a good day - we've only managed to do a few odd bits here and there," said one trader.
Milling wheat 11 percent protein fetched 115.50 stg for January in Tilbury and the middle of the country.
Feed wheat was trading around 97 to 97.50 stg for January in most areas with little forward trading reported.
The only trade in barley reported was in Yorkshire where January fetched 98 stg a tonne. --Jim Ballantyne, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8062
